name: Oku Shinji
source: Aoyagi Miyako boyfriend who confess her feelings for. When Miyako mother starts to interfere with his relationship he dose his best to resist her. Depending on the route there are two different out comes. [spoiler] For the domination route Shinji successfuly resist Yoshino advances but in turn Yoshino soon starts to fall in love with Shinji and Shinji in turn falls in love with Yoshino and takes her in as a secret girlfriend. For the submission route Shinji fails to resist Yoshino but in turn both Shinji and Yoshino only lust for once and another [/spoiler]
